name: Geo
subtitle: More detail, more precision, more clarity.
description: GEO’s aspheric geometry can reduce lens thickness while preserving a more natural appearance of the eyes behind the lenses.
intro: Its design helps preserve a more faithful view while minimizing visual distortions associated with high prescriptions.
details: Novar Geo is designed to reduce aberrations and improve visual quality across different viewing positions. An advanced single-vision option for people seeking greater precision in everyday use.
design: Personalized aspheric and atoric single-vision lens.
idealFor: People seeking higher visual quality in single-vision lenses.

technologies.name: Psicoptix Technology™
technologies.description: An exclusive Novar technology that combines advanced optics and visual neuroscience to create lenses that adapt to how you see the world. The result: more natural, comfortable, clear vision with every glance.

technologies.name: CDT Technology™
technologies.description: Just as an 8K screen builds an image from millions of pixels to reveal every detail with greater precision, this exclusive Novar technology optimizes the lens point by point. Each micro-zone contributes visual information to create a more defined, uniform, natural image and clearer vision across the entire field.

questions.question: What is Novar Geo?
questions.answer: It is a personalized single-vision lens designed for greater precision.

questions.question: Who is it recommended for?
questions.answer: For people seeking a more advanced single-vision experience.

questions.question: What makes it different?
questions.answer: Its optimization of aberrations and visual fields.

name: Slim
subtitle: Thinner on the outside. Smarter on the inside.
description: Designed to transform the experience for people with high prescriptions.
introHeading: Where others see thickness, Slim sees possibility.
intro: Its intelligent optimization of thickness and viewing area makes lenses thinner, lighter, and more refined, expands frame choices, and provides comfort from the start.
details: Novar Slim automatically selects and shifts the optical zone to reduce edge thickness in high-power lenses. This makes more refined, comfortable options possible, including frames that may have been harder to wear before.
idealFor: People with high positive or negative prescriptions
